title: NO SPOKEN ANNOUNCER, GAME SOUNDS INSTEAD
why: His order of 2026-10-13: get rid of all spoken sounds like WAVE INCOMING and just add game sounds instead. The only spoken clips left in the page were the ten announcer calls of v24.04 (DOUBLE KILL, TRIPLE KILL, MULTI KILL, RAMPAGE, UNSTOPPABLE, NEW HIGH SCORE, TWO MINUTES, ONE MINUTE, WAVE INCOMING and EXTRACTED). They are deleted with the code that decoded and played them. The on-screen callouts stay, and each moment now has a short sound of its own, built from oscillators on the sting bus like the game other stingers and quieter than a gunshot: a wave coming in is a low urgent alarm of two rising horn pulses; a kill streak is a rising chime ladder, one more note and a higher, brighter climb for every level; NEW HIGH SCORE is a bright arpeggio ending on a held top note; EXTRACTED is a chord that resolves; the two minute mark is a ticking clock and the one minute mark ticks faster and climbing, with a low pulse at the end. One at a time, nothing under G.sim, no seeded draw.
now: The announcer voice is gone: waves, kill streaks, high scores, extraction and the last minutes now have game sounds instead.
